pipeline._comment: CALIBRATE: camera_name matches supervisor.py's STEERING camera (ASI290MM, CAMERA_CONFIGS index 1 -- CHECK the index still points at this camera). width/height are 64 here (must be a multiple of 8) with start_x/start_y auto-centred, which puts the ROI at the SENSOR centre (968, 548) -- about 300 px from where the other configs place the beam (676, 350); set explicit start_x/start_y once the beam's sensor position is known so the ROI tracks it instead of the raw sensor centre. exposure/gain are 400 us / 0 as of 2026-08-06, matching the other live configs rather than the ASI SDK defaults (1000 us / 100) this shipped with; neither has been tuned against this beam's brightness.

Self-contained spiral search (devices/spiral_search.c). step/radius set the initial grid (normalised setpoint units per ring, rings outward -- ±step*radius is the first pass's reach). passes is the number of coarse-to-fine refinements (step/radius halve each pass). settle_frames is how many camera frames to wait after each move before trusting the brightness reading (covers camera exposure + mirror response); raise it if the mirror is slow to settle. threshold is subtracted from every pixel before summing -- CALIBRATE against real background/sensor noise (5 is a placeholder, same as the old center_of_mass config used).

OPTIONAL: mirrors supervisor.py's TELEMETRY_PORT so you can watch the search's commanded [y, x] live while it runs. Not required for the search itself -- delete this device if you don't need external monitoring.
Bound the command to the DAC's valid range before it reaches hardware.

Fast steering-mirror DAC (TI DAC81404) over the parallel-port SPI link (devices/parport_dac.c) -- link/pci/bar/offsets/sclk_bit/sdin_bit/sync_bit below are that file's own documented defaults, not guesses. CALIBRATE channel/index/scale/offset/range against the real mirror amplifier: channel 0/1 assumed to be DACA=y, DACB=x; scale/offset/range are the device defaults (1.0 V/unit, 0 V at zero, unipolar 0-10 V) and very likely wrong for this mirror's driver -- verify polarity and range on the bench (DAC output disconnected from the mirror) before connecting it.

params._range_2026_08_07: range 0-10 -> +-5 AND scale [1, 1] -> [-1, 1]. The 0-10 range was UNIPOLAR with the mirror parked at 0 V, so the entire negative half of every axis clipped to 0 V and half of each spiral arm was never actually commanded. +-5 gives the search both directions about the park. The scale also carried the pre-correction signs; see the sign note above.
